guarantees.claim: fifo_wdata_sel_o is cleared to zero when rst_ni is low.
fifo_wdata_sel_o is cleared to zero when clr_fifo_wdata_sel is asserted.
fifo_wdata_sel_o increments by 1 when both fifo_wsel_o and fifo_wvalid_o are true.
fifo_wdata_sel_o holds its previous value when none of the active conditions (reset, clear, write strobe) are true.

assumptions.claim: The write strobe condition (fifo_wsel_o && fifo_wvalid_o) must be asserted for exactly one clock cycle per write transaction.
assumptions.risk: If asserted continuously, fifo_wdata_sel_o increments every clock cycle, leading to incorrect data selection (wrap-around or skipping intended values).

uncertain_points.claim: fifo_wdata_sel_o can overflow and wrap-around because no saturation or error checking is included when it reaches maximum value.
uncertain_points.cond: fifo_wdata_sel_o increments beyond its bit-width limit
uncertain_points.risk: Wrap-around may select an unintended data source, potentially exposing or corrupting sensitive data in the HMAC core.

uncertain_points.claim: The duration of (fifo_wsel_o && fifo_wvalid_o) is not gated by this block; a level signal could cause multiple increments.
uncertain_points.cond: fifo_wsel_o && fifo_wvalid_o held high for >1 cycle
uncertain_points.risk: Unexpected multiple increments cause fifo_wdata_sel_o to skip intended values, leading to functional misbehavior or incorrect data selection.

uncertain_points.claim: The intended width and encoding (binary vs one-hot) of fifo_wdata_sel_o are not visible in this chunk, and whether the increment-by-1 behavior is correct for its use as a data select.
uncertain_points.risk: Misinterpretation may lead to incorrect point in the verification plan or integration assumptions.
